title: Kubernetes pod stuck in ImagePullBackOff
symptoms: New pods remain pending and kubectl shows ImagePullBackOff with a manifest unknown error
root_cause: The deployment referenced image tag v2.8.1 but that tag was not pushed to the container registry
resolution: Push the missing image or update the deployment to an existing tag then restart the rollout

title: Container repeatedly killed for exceeding memory
symptoms: Pod restarts every few minutes with exit code 137 and OOMKilled in its last state
root_cause: A traffic spike increased batch size while the container memory limit remained at 512Mi
resolution: Reduce batch size and raise the tested memory limit then monitor working set and restart count

title: Nginx cannot bind to HTTP port
symptoms: Nginx fails to start and logs bind to 0.0.0.0 port 80 failed address already in use
root_cause: An old Apache process was still listening on port 80 after a migration
resolution: Stop and disable the conflicting service verify the listener with ss then start Nginx

title: API returns intermittent database timeouts
symptoms: Requests intermittently return 500 errors and PostgreSQL connection acquisition times out during peak traffic
root_cause: The application connection pool allowed more connections than the database max_connections capacity
resolution: Lower and coordinate per-instance pool limits increase capacity if justified and alert on pool saturation

title: Node disk pressure evicts workloads
symptoms: Pods are evicted and the node reports DiskPressure while image pulls fail with no space left on device
root_cause: Unused container images and oversized application logs filled the node filesystem
resolution: Prune unused images rotate logs expand the volume and configure eviction and disk-usage alerts

title: Service cannot resolve internal hostnames
symptoms: Requests to internal services fail with temporary failure in name resolution and nslookup times out
root_cause: CoreDNS pods were CPU throttled after a large increase in DNS queries
resolution: Increase CoreDNS replicas and CPU limits add query monitoring and verify upstream resolver health

title: Redis latency after cache memory saturation
symptoms: Cache latency rises sharply and evicted_keys increases while memory usage stays at the maximum
root_cause: The cache used noeviction policy and stored unbounded session payloads without TTLs
resolution: Add TTLs cap payload sizes choose an appropriate eviction policy and resize after measuring the working set

title: Deployment rollout blocked by failed readiness probe
symptoms: New pods run but never become ready and the rollout reaches progress deadline exceeded
root_cause: The readiness probe path still used /health while the application endpoint changed to /health/ready
resolution: Update the probe path validate it inside the pod and resume the deployment rollout

title: TLS certificate expired on public endpoint
symptoms: Browsers reject HTTPS connections and synthetic checks report certificate has expired
root_cause: The certificate renewal job could not update the secret because its service account permissions were removed
resolution: Restore least-privilege secret update permission renew the certificate and alert well before expiry

title: High CPU caused by runaway application logging
symptoms: CPU usage stays above 95 percent and request latency climbs although traffic is normal
root_cause: Debug logging serialized large request payloads on every request after a configuration change
resolution: Restore info log level remove payload logging and add configuration validation and CPU alerts

title: Consumer lag grows on Kafka topic
symptoms: Kafka consumer lag grows continuously and billing events are processed hours late
root_cause: One consumer instance entered a crash loop and remaining consumers could not match partition throughput
resolution: Fix the crashing instance scale consumers up to the partition count and monitor processing rate versus ingress

title: GitHub Actions deployment cannot assume cloud role
symptoms: The CI job fails during cloud login with access denied for sts AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
root_cause: The role trust policy only allowed the old repository branch after the deployment workflow moved to main
resolution: Update the OIDC trust condition for the exact repository and branch then rerun the workflow

title: Load balancer returns 502 after release
symptoms: Users receive 502 Bad Gateway immediately after a release while containers appear healthy
root_cause: The application started on port 8081 but the service and load balancer target group still checked port 8080
resolution: Align container service and target ports verify health checks then perform a guarded rollout

title: PostgreSQL replica lag increases rapidly
symptoms: Read replicas serve stale data and replication lag rises during a bulk import
root_cause: The import generated write-ahead logs faster than the replica disk could apply them because of low IOPS
resolution: Throttle the import raise replica IOPS verify network throughput and monitor WAL replay delay

title: CronJob creates duplicate daily reports
symptoms: Customers receive two copies of the daily report and two jobs overlap around midnight
root_cause: The Kubernetes CronJob allowed concurrent runs and the first execution exceeded its normal duration
resolution: Set concurrencyPolicy to Forbid make report generation idempotent and alert on abnormal duration

title: Application cannot write to mounted volume
symptoms: The container logs permission denied when writing output files to the persistent volume
root_cause: The pod securityContext ran as UID 10001 but the mounted directory was owned by root and had no matching group permission
resolution: Set an appropriate fsGroup or pre-provision correct ownership then verify with a non-root container

title: Messages accumulate in dead-letter queue
symptoms: The dead-letter queue grows and email notifications are missing for a subset of users
root_cause: A newly required template variable was absent in older events causing rendering exceptions
resolution: Support a default value replay validated dead-letter messages and add schema compatibility tests

title: Terraform apply fails because state is locked
symptoms: Terraform exits saying the state is locked even though no apply job is currently running
root_cause: A cancelled CI runner left a stale lock record in the remote backend
resolution: Confirm no active writer remove only the verified stale lock with force-unlock and serialize apply jobs

title: Autoscaler does not add pods under load
symptoms: Request latency and CPU rise but the HorizontalPodAutoscaler continues to show unknown metrics
root_cause: The metrics-server certificate was invalid so the resource metrics API was unavailable
resolution: Repair the metrics-server certificate verify kubectl top output and confirm HPA metrics and scaling events

title: Liveness probe causes cascading restarts
symptoms: All replicas restart during a slow downstream dependency and availability drops to zero
root_cause: The liveness endpoint checked database connectivity and failed whenever the database response slowed
resolution: Make liveness test only process health use readiness for dependencies and tune thresholds using observed startup times

title: Requests rejected after API rate limit reached
symptoms: Partner API calls return HTTP 429 and the retry queue grows rapidly
root_cause: Workers retried immediately without jitter and collectively exceeded the partner quota
resolution: Implement exponential backoff with jitter honor Retry-After cap concurrency and monitor quota consumption

title: Secrets unavailable after namespace migration
symptoms: New pods fail at startup because the referenced secret cannot be found
root_cause: The deployment moved namespaces but its secret was not recreated in the destination namespace
resolution: Create the secret through the approved secret manager update references and verify RBAC without copying plaintext

title: Elasticsearch cluster turns read only
symptoms: Indexing stops with a cluster block error and searches return increasingly stale results
root_cause: Disk usage crossed the flood-stage watermark and Elasticsearch applied a read-only block
resolution: Free or expand disk space adjust retention then clear the block only after disk usage is safely below the watermark

title: Clock skew breaks signed requests
symptoms: Signed API requests fail authentication intermittently and logs say signature is not yet valid
root_cause: NTP synchronization was disabled on one virtual machine and its clock drifted several minutes
resolution: Restore time synchronization correct the clock safely and alert on host time offset
